cat > forgemyspec-bundle/csv-analytics/spec.yaml <<'EOF'
version: "0.1"
title: "CSV Analytics Tool"
objective: "A single-file, stdlib-only Python CLI/library (csv_analytics.py) that reads CSV files, computes per-column statistics, filters rows, selects columns and exports a JSON report."
execution_mode: critical
context:
  system: "Empty Python 3 repository; deliverable is csv_analytics.py at the repo root with unittest tests under tests/."
  assumptions:
    - "The first CSV row is a header naming the columns."
    - "A column is numeric for stats when every non-empty cell parses as a float; empty cells are skipped and not counted."
    - "stdev is the sample standard deviation (n-1); it is null when fewer than 2 values exist."
    - "Filter syntax is COLUMN OP VALUE with OP in ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=; numeric comparison when both sides parse as numbers, string comparison otherwise; multiple filters are ANDed."
    - "Non-numeric columns report only count (non-empty cells), and min/max are lexicographic; mean, median and stdev are null."
constraints:
  - "Only the Python standard library is used; no third-party packages."
  - "All code lives in the single file csv_analytics.py."
  - "No GUI, no database, no network access, no writing of CSV output."
  - "No aggregation functions beyond count, min, max, mean, median and stdev."
success_criteria:
  - "Running the tool on a CSV prints or writes a JSON report with count, min, max, mean, median and stdev per column."
  - "Filters and column selection change which rows and columns the report covers."
  - "Bad input (missing file, unknown column, bad filter) exits non-zero with a clear message."
hypotheses:
  - {id: h1, description: "The tool reads a CSV file with a header row into rows keyed by column name.", confidence: 0.95}
  - {id: h2, description: "For each numeric column the tool computes count, min, max, mean, median and sample stdev correctly.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h3, description: "Row filters keep only rows matching every given condition.", confidence: 0.85}
  - {id: h4, description: "Column selection restricts rows and the report to the named columns, in the given order.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h5, description: "The tool exports a valid JSON report to a file or stdout.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h6, description: "Invalid input (missing file, unknown column, malformed filter) exits with code 2 and a message naming the problem.", confidence: 0.85}
required_evidence:
  - "unittest run output of tests/ with all tests passing"
  - "gate command output ending in RESULT: PASS"
  - "sample CLI run output showing the JSON report"
actions:
  - {id: a1, description: "Implement CSV reading, stats, filters, column selection and JSON export in csv_analytics.py", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
  - {id: a2, description: "Write unittest boundary tests for each obligation", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
  - {id: a3, description: "Run the gate and the sample CLI and review the output", type: validate, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
decision_rules:
  - "If a filter or stats semantics question arises that the assumptions do not settle, stop and ask the user."
  - "Anything outside the listed features is a spec amendment."
metadata:
  source_prompt: "Build a CSV Analytics Tool. Read CSV files, compute per-column stats (count, min, max, mean, median, stdev), filter rows, select columns, export JSON report. Single file csv_analytics.py, stdlib only."
  generator: claude-code-session
  scope_contract:
    must_include:
      - "read CSV files"
      - "per-column stats count min max mean median stdev"
      - "filter rows"
      - "select columns"
      - "export JSON report"
      - "single file csv_analytics.py"
      - "stdlib only"
formal:
  module: CsvAnalytics
  obligations:
    - id: read_csv
      kind: boundary
      statement: "A CSV file with a header is read into rows keyed by column name; a missing file exits 2."
      hypotheses: [h1, h6]
      must_include: ["read CSV files"]
      test: "test_csv_analytics.CsvTests.test_read_csv"
    - id: column_stats
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Numeric columns report count, min, max, mean, median and sample stdev; empty cells are skipped; stdev is null for fewer than 2 values."
      hypotheses: [h2]
      must_include: ["per-column stats count min max mean median stdev"]
      test: "test_csv_analytics.CsvTests.test_column_stats"
    - id: filter_rows
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Filters COLUMN OP VALUE are ANDed and keep only matching rows; a malformed filter or unknown column exits 2."
      hypotheses: [h3, h6]
      must_include: ["filter rows"]
      test: "test_csv_analytics.CsvTests.test_filter_rows"
    - id: select_columns
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Column selection keeps only the named columns in the given order; an unknown column exits 2."
      hypotheses: [h4, h6]
      must_include: ["select columns"]
      test: "test_csv_analytics.CsvTests.test_select_columns"
    - id: export_json
      kind: boundary
      statement: "The report is valid JSON written to the --output file or to stdout."
      hypotheses: [h5]
      must_include: ["export JSON report"]
      test: "test_csv_analytics.CsvTests.test_export_json"
    - id: single_file_stdlib
      kind: boundary
      statement: "csv_analytics.py imports only standard-library modules and no other project module."
      hypotheses: [h1]
      must_include: ["single file csv_analytics.py", "stdlib only"]
      test: "test_csv_analytics.CsvTests.test_stdlib_only"
scope:
  paths: ["csv_analytics.py", "tests/**"]
  tests: tests
  pythonpath: ["."]
EOF
export PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness
python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/csv-analytics/spec.yaml --formal && python3 -m forgemyspec package forgemyspec-bundle/csv-analytics/spec.yaml
